name: Coding Agents Service
description: Finds coding-agent CLIs on a node and runs their headless mode as conversations.

tools.name: agents_detect
tools.description:
The coding-agent CLIs installed on this node and the ways PantheonOS can run each.

Args:
    refresh: Detect again now instead of using the result from the last five minutes.

tools.name: agent_terminal_command
tools.description:
The shell command that opens an agent's own interface, for pty_open, and the terminal session it reports to.

Args:
    agent: Catalog id (claude, codex, gemini, cursor, ...) or a custom agent's id.
    resume: The agent's session id to reopen.
    auto: Start in full-auto mode (no approval prompts).
    cwd: The folder, recorded with the terminal session.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.description:
Send a message to a coding agent and start its turn. Events stream on pantheon.stream.coding_<conversation_id>.

Args:
    prompt: The message.
    agent: Catalog id; needed for a new conversation.
    cwd: Folder the agent works in; a new conversation only. Defaults to home.
    conversation_id: Continue this conversation.
    model: Model name the agent understands.
    auto: Full-auto mode for a new conversation.
    origin: Who started it (ui, agent, cli).
    session_id: Continue this session of the agent's own (one started outside PantheonOS) as a new conversation.
    title: The new conversation's title.

tools.name: agent_conversations
tools.description: Conversations on this node, newest first.

tools.name: agent_conversation
tools.description: A conversation and its events after seq `after`; `more` means call again from the last seq.

tools.name: agent_delete
tools.description: Remove a conversation's record on this node. The agent's own session is kept.

tools.name: agent_sessions
tools.description:
The sessions the agents keep themselves on this node (also those started outside PantheonOS), newest first, with the conversation that continues each.

Args:
    agent: Only this agent's sessions.
    limit: How many (default 50, at most 200).

tools.name: agent_terminals
tools.description: Agents opened in Terminal windows in the last day, with what each is doing (ready, working, waiting for the user, ended).

tools.name: agents_settings
tools.description: How the agents on this node are set up: per agent (hidden, command, args, env, model, auto), custom agents, and whether agents may use PantheonOS. The key itself is never returned.

tools.name: agents_configure
tools.description:
Change the agents' settings, the custom agents, or the project list on this node; a field left out keeps what the node has.

Args:
    agents: {agent id: {hidden, command, args, env, model, auto}}.
    custom: [{id, label, command, env}] — agents run in a terminal by a command line.
    projects: [{path}] — folders on this node whose sessions the desktop lists.

tools.name: agents_access
tools.description:
Let agents on this node use PantheonOS through the pantheon command with a platform key made for the node; an empty key turns it off. Returns replaced_key_id when another key was in place, for the caller to revoke.

Args:
    key: The platform key (pbk_...).
    key_id: Its id, for revoking it later.
    hub_url: The Hub it belongs to.

tools.name: agents_browse
tools.description:
List the folders in a folder on this node (home when empty), for picking a project.

Args:
    path: the folder to list.

tools.name: agents_create_project
tools.description:
Make a new folder on this node for a project, optionally a git repository, and add it to the project list.

Args:
    parent: where to make it (home when empty).
    name: the folder name.
    git: run git init in it.

tools.name: agent_sessions_import
tools.description:
List these agents' own sessions in the desktop, as if started here.

Args:
    sessions: [{agent, id}].

tools.name: agent_sessions_forget
tools.description:
Stop listing these sessions in the desktop; the sessions stay with their agents.

Args:
    sessions: [{agent, id}].

tools.name: agents_workspace_create
tools.description:
Make a git worktree of a project on a new branch (or an existing one of that name), beside the project's folder, and list it as a workspace of the project.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    name: the branch, and the workspace's name.

tools.name: agents_workspace_remove
tools.description:
Take a workspace off its project's list; with remove, also remove its git worktree (git refuses while it has uncommitted changes). The branch stays.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    path: the workspace's folder.
    remove: remove the worktree too.

notes: Go implementation compiled into the fleet runner (this directory's .go files); see docs/apps/coding-agents.md.
